primary_method.name: DCF
primary_method.reasoning: Coherent generates positive and rising free cash flow with a clear AI-datacom revenue ramp and a deleveraging balance sheet, so a long-horizon FCFF DCF captures the path better than a trailing multiple. An EV/EBITDA cross-check anchors the rich post-run valuation.

wacc.reasoning: Ke = 4.3% Rf + 1.45 beta x 5.0% ERP = 11.55%. Beta above the semi average for transceiver price-cyclicality and post-merger leverage. A ~20% after-tax debt weight on the remaining II-VI/Coherent debt pulls WACC to ~10.2%, inside the 9-12% semi band.
wacc.adjudication_notes: 10.2% is mid semi band; justified by transceiver cyclicality and residual leverage.

terminal_growth.reasoning: 3.0% terminal: optical content should outgrow GDP as clusters scale, but components face perpetual price pressure, so terminal sits at a mature-semis rate.

fcf_projections.rationale: FY26E +20%: datacom transceiver (800G/1.6T) ramp for AI clusters is the engine; telecom and industrial-laser segments recover modestly. Margin lifts as datacom mix rises.
+17.5%: 1.6T ramp and indium-phosphide laser vertical integration lift gross margin; deleveraging cuts interest drag.
+15%: AI optical content per cluster keeps compounding; operating leverage on the merged II-VI/Coherent cost base.
+13%: share gains in CPO-adjacent components; margin nears high-teens EBIT.
+11%: growth moderates off a larger base; materials and networking segments steady.
+6.5%: approaching steady state, low-20s EBIT margin franchise.

cross_check.name: Multiple
cross_check.reasoning: EV/EBITDA is the right cross-check for a profitable optical-components maker. Peer set: optical/photonics and AI-networking names. A generous 22x forward EBITDA still anchors well below where the post-run share price sits.

inputs.reasoning: 22x applied to FY26E EBITDA of ~$1.45B (≈21% margin on $6.96B). Rich for the cohort, chosen to give the AI-optical bull case its due.

scenarios.label: Bear
scenarios.probability_reasoning: A full quarter-weight. The datacom transceiver market is brutally competitive (InnoLight, Eoptolink), pricing resets each generation, and the stock has 5x'd off its low, leaving no margin for a single soft quarter.
scenarios.reasoning: Transceiver pricing compresses faster than volume grows, CPO disintermediates pluggables sooner than expected, and the debt load amplifies the equity hit.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.probability_reasoning: Central case. AI optical content keeps compounding and the merged cost base delivers margin, but the share price already discounts a long, smooth ramp.
scenarios.reasoning: Steady datacom-led growth decelerating from 20% to high-single-digits, EBIT margin grinding from 13% to low-20s.

scenarios.label: Bull
scenarios.probability_reasoning: Lower odds. Requires 1.6T and co-packaged-optics content to inflect faster than modeled and indium-phosphide vertical integration to lift margins above plan.
scenarios.reasoning: Coherent becomes the preferred Western optical-engine supplier; revenue and margins beat the base path materially.

weights_reasoning: Bear gets a heavy 25% because transceiver pricing resets and a 5x run leave the stock exposed to any single soft print. Base 45% for the constructive AI-optical ramp. Bull 15% for the CPO/1.6T acceleration. Cross-check 20% anchors intrinsic value against the peer multiple.
